scope: Theorem 7.2 of the manuscript “The Artinian Lex-Plus-Powers Betti Theorem” (preprints/The-Artinian-Lex-Plus-Powers-Betti-Theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 200 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 81874e1994ff2773), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let r ≥ 1, let 2 ≤ a1 ≤ · · · ≤ ar, and let A = C[x1, . . . , xr]. Suppose that H ⊆ A is a monomial ideal containing (xa1 1 , . . . , xar r ) and is stable in the box. Let G = ΛH be its degreewise lex replacement inside the box, together with the prescribed pure powers. Then, for every p ≥ 0 and j ∈ Z, βA p,j(H) ≤ βA p,j(G), βA p,j(A/H) ≤ βA p,j(A/G).
